{{Quote|Put him into cryo-cycle stasis and stack him somewhere.|Jos Vondar|<ref name="Intermezzo">{{InsiderCite|83|MedStar: Intermezzo}}</ref>}}
'''Cryo-cycle stasis''' was a medically-induced slowdown of physical functions. A few [[Standard hour/Legends|hours]] in this suspended state of animation was all a body could take before [[Death/Legends|shutting down]] completely. This was used to allow [[Doctor/Legends|surgeons]] to investigate a problem with a lesser hurry.<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|I|154|cryo-cycle stasis}}</ref>
